web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationComparison.title: Allocations beside task estimates
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationComparison.basis: Three separate measures by project discipline and due week. Confirmed and Proposed are allocation approval states; remaining estimates use task progress, exclude Complete, Cancelled and On Hold work, and are never added to allocated hours. This context is independent of allocation-list filters and paging.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationComparison.partial: Allocation figures cover only rows you may view and are lower bounds, not complete project totals. Task estimates cover the project's visible active work.
